query: SELECT pz.id, pz.partId, pz.zoneType, pz.label, pz.posX, pz.posY, pz.width, pz.height, pp.`key` as partKey, pp.label as partLabel FROM product_zones pz JOIN product_parts pp ON pz.partId = pp.id WHERE pp.productId = 1380006 ORDER BY pp.`key`, pz.zoneType;
